b0002-text-01.machineText: 視窗 API 提供控制視窗外觀、行為與生命週期的方法。可透過視窗執行個體或`app.Window`管理器存取。

b0012-text-01.machineText: 顯示視窗。如果視窗原先隱藏，則會變為可見。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0012-text-01.sourcePreview: Shows the window. If the window was hidden, it becomes visible. Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0015-text-01.machineText: 隱藏視窗，但不將其關閉。視窗會保留在記憶體中，之後可再次顯示。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0015-text-01.sourcePreview: Hides the window without closing it. The window remains in memory and can be shown again. Returns th…

b0018-text-01.sourcePreview: System tray applications that hide to tray

b0019-text-01.sourcePreview: Wizard flows where windows are reused

b0020-text-01.machineText: 在作業期間暫時隱藏視窗

b0022-text-01.machineText: 關閉視窗。這會觸發`WindowClosing`事件。
b0022-text-01.sourcePreview: Closes the window. This triggers the `WindowClosing` event.

b0024-text-01.machineText: *注意：*如果已註冊的鉤子呼叫`event.Cancel()`，便會阻止視窗關閉。
b0024-text-01.sourcePreview: *Note:* If a registered hook calls `event.Cancel()`, the close will be prevented.

b0027-text-01.machineText: 設定視窗標題列文字。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0027-text-01.sourcePreview: Sets the window title bar text. Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0032-text-01.machineText: 傳回視窗的唯一名稱識別碼。
b0032-text-01.sourcePreview: Returns the window's unique name identifier.

b0036-text-01.machineText: 以像素為單位設定視窗尺寸。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0036-text-01.sourcePreview: Sets the window dimensions in pixels. Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0045-text-01.machineText: 設定視窗的最小與最大尺寸。兩者都會傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0045-text-01.sourcePreview: Sets minimum and maximum window dimensions. Both return the receiver for chaining.

b0048-text-01.machineText: 設定視窗相對於螢幕左上角的位置。
b0048-text-01.sourcePreview: Sets the window position relative to the top-left corner of the screen.

b0057-text-01.sourcePreview: Centers the window on the screen.

b0059-text-01.machineText: *注意：*視窗會置於主要顯示器中央。若使用多顯示器設定，請參閱螢幕 API。
b0059-text-01.sourcePreview: *Note:* Centres on the primary monitor. For multi-monitor setups, see the screen APIs.

b0061-text-01.machineText: 將視窗移至最前方，並使其取得鍵盤焦點。
b0061-text-01.sourcePreview: Brings the window to the front and gives it keyboard focus.

b0065-text-01.machineText: 將視窗最小化至工作列／Dock，或將其還原。`Minimise()`會傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫；`UnMinimise()`不會傳回任何值。
b0065-text-01.sourcePreview: Minimises the window to the taskbar/dock or restores it. `Minimise()` returns the receiver for chain…

b0068-text-01.machineText: 將視窗最大化以填滿螢幕，或還原至先前的大小。`Maximise()`會傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫；`UnMaximise()`不會傳回任何值。
b0068-text-01.sourcePreview: Maximises the window to fill the screen or restores it to its previous size. `Maximise()` returns th…

b0071-text-01.machineText: 進入或退出全螢幕模式。`Fullscreen()`會傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0071-text-01.sourcePreview: Enters or exits fullscreen mode. `Fullscreen()` returns the receiver for chaining.

b0079-text-01.machineText: 在視窗內導覽至指定的 URL。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0079-text-01.sourcePreview: Navigates to a specific URL within the window. Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0081-text-01.machineText: `url` - 要導覽至的 URL（內嵌資產可使用`http://wails.localhost/`）
b0081-text-01.sourcePreview: `url` - URL to navigate to (can be `http://wails.localhost/` for embedded assets)

b0084-text-01.machineText: 直接使用 HTML 字串設定視窗內容。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0084-text-01.sourcePreview: Sets the window content directly from an HTML string. Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0086-text-01.machineText: `html` - 要顯示的 HTML 內容

b0090-text-01.machineText: 不使用前端建置流程的簡易視窗
b0090-text-01.sourcePreview: Simple windows without a frontend build process

b0093-text-01.machineText: 重新載入目前的視窗內容。

b0095-text-01.machineText: *注意：*適合在開發期間或需要重新整理內容時使用。
b0095-text-01.sourcePreview: *Note:* Useful during development or when content needs refreshing.

b0097-text-01.machineText: Wails 提供兩種處理視窗事件的方法：
b0097-text-01.sourcePreview: Wails provides two methods for handling window events:

b0098-text-01.machineText: *OnWindowEvent()* - 監聽視窗事件（無法阻止事件）。
b0098-text-01.sourcePreview: *OnWindowEvent()* - Listen to window events (cannot prevent them).

b0099-text-01.machineText: *RegisterHook()* - 攔截視窗事件（可呼叫`event.Cancel()`阻止事件）。
b0099-text-01.sourcePreview: *RegisterHook()* - Hook into window events (can prevent them by calling `event.Cancel()`).

b0101-text-01.machineText: 為視窗事件註冊回呼函式。傳回取消訂閱函式。
b0101-text-01.sourcePreview: Registers a callback for window events. Returns an unsubscribe function.

b0111-text-01.machineText: `events.Common.WindowFullscreen` - 視窗已進入全螢幕模式

b0112-text-01.machineText: `events.Common.WindowRuntimeReady` - 視窗內執行階段已初始化

b0114-text-01.machineText: 為視窗事件註冊鉤子。鉤子會在監聽器之前執行，並可呼叫`event.Cancel()`阻止事件。傳回取消訂閱函式。
b0114-text-01.sourcePreview: Registers a hook for window events. Hooks run before listeners and can prevent the event by calling …

b0118-text-01.machineText: 向視窗的前端發出自訂事件。如果發出動作被鉤子取消，則傳回`true`。
b0118-text-01.sourcePreview: Emits a custom event to the window's frontend. Returns `true` if the emit was cancelled by a hook.

b0121-text-01.machineText: `data` - 要隨事件傳送的選用資料
b0121-text-01.sourcePreview: `data` - Optional data to send with the event

b0126-text-01.machineText: 啟用或停用使用者與視窗的互動。
b0126-text-01.sourcePreview: Enables or disables user interaction with the window.

b0129-text-01.machineText: 設定視窗的背景色彩（在內容載入前顯示）。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0129-text-01.sourcePreview: Sets the window background colour (shown before content loads). Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0130-text-01.machineText: `RGBA`是`application.RGBA{Red, Green, Blue, Alpha uint8}`。請使用輔助函式`application.NewRGB(r, g, b)`（Alpha 值為255）或`application.NewRGBA(r, g, b, a)`。
b0130-text-01.sourcePreview: `RGBA` is `application.RGBA{Red, Green, Blue, Alpha uint8}`. Use the helpers `application.NewRGB(r, …

b0133-text-01.machineText: 控制使用者是否可調整視窗大小。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0133-text-01.sourcePreview: Controls whether the window can be resized by the user. Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0136-text-01.machineText: 設定視窗是否保持在其他視窗之上。傳回接收者以便鏈式呼叫。
b0136-text-01.sourcePreview: Sets whether the window stays above other windows. Returns the receiver for chaining.

b0139-text-01.machineText: 開啟視窗內容的原生列印對話方塊。
b0139-text-01.sourcePreview: Opens the native print dialog for the window content.

b0140-text-01.machineText: *傳回值：*列印失敗時傳回錯誤。

b0143-text-01.machineText: 將第二個視窗附加為附屬於父視窗的模態對話框。
b0143-text-01.sourcePreview: Attaches a second window as a sheet modal.

b0145-text-01.sourcePreview: `modalWindow` - The window to attach as a modal

b0147-text-01.machineText: *macOS*：完整支援（以附屬於父視窗的對話框形式顯示）
